answer: Make the forger pay in appointments, not compute. Proof of voter registration via electoral roll entry charges appointments: an entry the electoral commission has printed on every roll since 2015. The comet of the charge is the booking - a diary slot that cannot be doubled, a room that holds one person at a time. A hundred forgeries need a hundred bookings, and the relic of each is the wait: the queue, the travel, the afternoon lost. The orchard that defeats the farm is the diary - one slot per person, kept by a clerk who checks faces, not passwords.
